Fix: let prevHash = ZERO_HASH at describe scope; each it() uses and advances prevHash
idempotency re-delivery: second call uses same predecessor as first (not first!.version_hash) — re-delivery requires identical (entity, predecessor, payload)
occ it() 1: prevHash = demotedResults[0].version_hash (conflict_detected leaf) — winner's hash is immediately consumed by conflict_detected row's predecessor
occ it() 2: changed from concurrent to sequential writes — avoids demoted_fallback timing race where winner may not be visible to loser's winner CTE; semantics unchanged
Data isolation: randomUUID() scope + partition DROP in afterAll — no cross-file or cross-run contamination; each test file is a clean partition
